next_step: Finalize POC runbook, pick vector DB, confirm ingestion windows; kickoff POC week of 2025-11-10.
notes:
Summary: mid-market CCaaS provider building agent-assist + ticket-summarization layer for enterprise customers. Focused on RAG over multi-source KBs (Zendesk, Confluence, GDrive, internal Postgres dumps).

Key asks: provenance/citations for agent answers, freshness (near-real-time sync for high-touch accounts), multi-source retrieval with reranking, tool-calling to update tickets and run macros in Zendesk, guaranteed reliability during spikes (Black Friday-like events), and clear cost controls. Wants demo of citation UI + fallback to condensed answer when source conflict.

Quotes from discovery: "Agents won't trust answers without provenance — they want a link + excerpt." 

Tech notes: plan to keep full-text in vector store w/ TTL for freshness; metadata to surface ticket id + source + timestamp for citations. Need suggestions on prefix caching for common flows (password resets, plan changes). Concerned about embedding PII handling and whether embeddings stored outside VPC. Wants KMS keys for encryption and audit trail on retrievals.

Operational: 6-month POC with 3 live contact centers, 3k agents, target p95 latency < 200ms for agent-assist retrieval path, throughput target 15k QPS peak (burst), cost sensitivity around token/embedding unit economics. Interested in Redwood's automatic batching/caching + fallback routing to cheaper model under heavy load.

Engagement tone: pragmatic, engineering-first. Security team requested SOC2/ISO artifacts and architecture diagram. Sales asked to provide vector DB comparisons and a short architecture oAuth flow for tool-calling (Zendesk service account).
